# Shield (`spells:shield`)
**Level 1 [Abjuration](../magic-schools/abjuration.md)** | **Casting Time:** Reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** 1 round | **Classes:** [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.
